idea: Design a codex-native orchestration layer that could RETIRE the crews plugin entirely (operator lean: full replacement), leveraging the codex app-server daemon + multi-agent-v2 + native async message-injection. Verify feasibility rigorously; produce an honest GO/PARTIAL/NO-GO verdict with a gap inventory and migration path, confronting the prior 'complementary' verdict.

candidateDirections.name: SHRINK crews to the durable+operator layer; move only in-session fan-out to codex-native
candidateDirections.summary: Partial reduction: port 3-wide in-session fan-out (brainstorm lenses, plan reviewers, Phase 5.5 retrospectives) to codex multi-agent v2/app-server within the 4-thread cap and adopt the codex-native WAKE per durable-mailbox-channel-wake.md, while KEEPING crews' thin filesystem mailbox + operator review-gate layer until codex grows the residual primitives. Sheds wt.exe-tab spawn fragility without a Layer-B rewrite.

candidateDirections.name: NOT-YET full replacement: build app-server peer-session orchestration first
candidateDirections.summary: The operator's full-replacement lean, honestly scoped as an XL second-system rewrite. Seams exist (spawn_top_level_session.rs for peer spawn, agentComms/ as a started durable layer, MCP-notif wake), but it RELOCATES fragility into happy-cli rather than removing it, re-implements battle-tested Layer-B behavior from scratch, and silently drops cross-engine model diversity. Gated on Windows app-server lifecycle + durable cross-session mailbox + operator-gate product. Verdict: NOT-YET.

candidateDirections.name: Cheaper non-rewrite alternatives: point-fix crews' Windows hot spots; decide cross-engine explicitly
candidateDirections.summary: Target crews' localized Windows-fragility hot spots (EPERM/rename lock race, listener silent-reap) with heartbeat-liveness + auto re-arm, far cheaper than a substrate swap; and make dropping cross-engine an explicit operator decision rather than a silent capability deletion. Validate by bisecting the last ~20 crash incidents.

questionsForSynthesis: Is the operator's pain primarily (a) wt.exe tab/process spawning, (b) on-disk lock contention / EPERM rename races, or (c) the hook-heavy Node surface itself? Only (c) truly motivates full replacement.

Will the operator stop using copilot/claude brainstorm/plan lenses? If not, full codex-only replacement silently deletes cross-engine model diversity this very brainstorm depends on (brainstorm-with-ralph SKILL.md:113-161).

Given plans/durable-mailbox-channel-wake.md §3 already rejected codex-native crews storage and kept the filesystem mailbox, does 'codex-native replacement' really mean 'crews mailbox + operator gates rewritten in TypeScript under happy-cli/agentComms'? If so, what NEW capability justifies the rewrite over hardening crews in place?
Is app-server thread-level isolation (one daemon, N threads) acceptable, or must the replacement preserve separate OS/top-level sessions for fault isolation + per-tab operator attach?
What concrete primitive must ship next to flip PARTIAL -> GO: durable peer mailbox, operator gates, or Windows app-server session lifecycle?
